title: Automa Campaign & Matrix Fleet Configuration
description: JSON Schema specification for Automa multi-workflow campaigns (*.campaign.json, *.campaigns.json)

description.description: Detailed summary or instructions for this campaign

workflows.description: List of workflows or matrix fleet member definitions

path.description: Relative path to the workflow file

browserId.description: Specific browser profile ID to execute this workflow on

members.description: Alternative key for campaign fleet members

concurrency_mode.description: Concurrency strategy when running multiple fleet workflows

max_concurrent.description: Maximum number of simultaneous browser sessions

stop_on_error.description: Immediately stop the whole campaign if any single workflow fails

delay_between_workflows.description: Cooldown delay in milliseconds between consecutive workflow executions

cron.description: Cron expression for automated recurring scheduled execution (e.g. '0 9 * * *' for daily at 9am)

cron_enabled.description: Whether the cron schedule is actively running
